fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 1.9 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2015.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company uses a mixture of purchased call options, collar structures (purchased call + sold put), call spreads (purchased call + sold call), put spreads (purchased put + sold put), and fixed price swap agreements. This filing added 'put spreads' to the instrument mix description.

warnings: pct_hedged_current_year (34%) refers to FY2014 settled hedges per Note 10: 'For 2014, the Company had fuel derivative instruments in place for up to 34 percent of its fuel consumption.'

pct_hedged_next_year = 0%: Note 10 states 'the Company has reduced its hedge position related to future years, and thus has no economic hedge in place for its 2015 estimated fuel consumption' as of December 31, 2014.
2015 and 2018 positions were offset via counterparty transactions during Q4 2014; Company paid $217 million to purchase offsetting derivatives. Losses on original derivatives substantially locked in.

net_fair_value_mm of -1,001 sourced from Note 10 counterparty credit table Total column showing $(1,001) million fair value of fuel derivatives at December 31, 2014. Item 7A rounds to 'net liability of $1.0 billion'.
2016 volumes are described as maximum economic hedge; may vary as market prices fluctuate.
WTI crude oil derivatives still do not qualify for hedge accounting (established in 2013); all fair value changes recorded directly to earnings.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel and oil expense table: average cost $5,355 million, average cost per gallon $2.97 (Item 1, 2018 10-K filing, restated)
